claims.text: Many reviewers say the product smooths frizz and leaves hair soft and sleek.
Several reviewers praise the natural, vegan, cruelty-free, fragrance-free formula with no gunky residue.
Some reviewers report it helps mend or tame split ends, though others are unsure it helps.
A few reviewers say the product did nothing for their hair or left it dry and with buildup.
A couple of reviewers mention issues with size or price, including receiving a smaller bottle than advertised and finding it expensive.
